build_structure_module: build a python module to run the AlphaFold multimer StructureModule for protein structure prediction
run_generate_monomer_rigids: run generate_monomer_rigids to iteratively predict residue rigid transformations for a single protein chain
test_invariant_point_attention: test the InvariantPointAttention module to compute geometric aware attention between protein residues in 3D space
review_multi_rigid_sidechain: review the MultiRigidSidechain class to predict sidechain atom positions from torsion angles and backbone frames
refactor_quat_rigid: refactor the QuatRigid module to project neural network activations into rigid transformations via quaternions
